description: Stage Route Model hardware profile. Stage partitions and workloads are generated online from transformed TTIR; this file contains no workload-specific Stage template or route multiplier.

selection_calibration.description: Cost parameters used by Stage models. They influence numerical cost only; coverage, confidence, Event validation, and gain-margin admission gates are not part of online route selection.
selection_calibration.source: Stage costs are calibrated from shared microbenchmarks and the same-shape, one-physical-core Ascend950PR_9599 solve_tril CaModel runs. Event data is retained outside the online profile as validation evidence, not as a route multiplier or admission gate.

simd_structural_penalty_ratio.description: Additive SIMD-only residual ratios for irregular addressing, mask materialization, reductions, loops, control flow, tiny dot, and rank-1 indirect reduction patterns. Their sum multiplies A_SIMD; A_SIMT never participates in the all-SIMD cost.

histogram.description: Calibrated tt.histogram rows in AIV system cycles per histogram call. tt.histogram is priced here instead of through an operation rate because its cost lives inside the lowering (dhistv2 template instructions, or the simt_only atomicAdd loop) and never appears in TTIR. Row selection mirrors the lowering gates and lives in the C++ model; this section only supplies structure constants and coefficients.

simd_template.description: dhistv2 SIMD template rows, used by every compile mode except simt_only. Rows are keyed by the shape that selects them: dtype, whether num_bins fits one 256-lane segment (bins_lt_256 or bins_256) or spans several segments (bins_gt_256), and whether a mask is present. u8/s8, u16/s16, and u32/s32 share a row per shape because the lowering generates byte-identical signless-integer code. u8 has one row because a u8 value can never reach bins >= 256, and u64 only has the bins <= 256 shapes because that is all the u64 gate admits.

simt_template.description: Template SIMT atomicAdd fallback rows, queued when the dhistv2 gate fails. per_elem is the sum of a scan and an in-range count part; the count part charges the data-dependent n_counted at its worst case n.

simt_only.description: simt_only IR-lowering rows (HistogramOpToLLVM.cpp). The atomicAdd is emitted for every element, so there is no n_counted term and masked calls reuse the unmasked coefficients. Fitted on 322 in-domain cases over 8 dtypes and num_warps 1..64, limited to a per-thread footprint of at most 128 elements and below 1024 bytes; larger footprints either degrade 1.5-1.8x or fault the device.

histogram.source: Device-side sweep on dav-c310 (950PR), dual-binary A/B (dhistv2 template vs SIMT-only baseline), per-path least squares with a 20% pre-registration holdout: derivation median APE <= 3.7% and holdout median APE <= 5.5% per dhistv2 path, dhistv2-vs-SIMT route agreement 98.4%. The u16/u32/u64 dhistv2 rows were re-measured on the restructured template (246-case sweep). The simt_only rows come from a separate R-stepped sweep of the IR lowering (322 in-domain cases, 5-fold cross-validation worst-width median APE 4.7%). Coefficients are target-specific and must be re-fitted when the lowering template, the unified-buffer size, or the target changes; see costmodel/profiles/microbench/data_provider/camodel/histogram_costmodel_notes.md.

prefix_scan.description: Normalize the recorded A5 batch-8, extent-16 identity-subtracted scan ratio by base shuffle rates: factor_SIMD = (143.398 / 8.267) * 64 / (32 * 0.817124) * factor_SIMT. The model charges lane_steps / lane_rate * factor, so the measured time ratio is not itself the factor. This effective calibration includes lowering effects, not intrinsic latency or forward/reverse asymmetry. Recalibrate if base rates or lowering change.

atomic_memory.description: Atomic RMW is priced independently from ordinary store and from loaded-index load traffic. Unknown runtime contention uses a route-relative conservative multiplier; it is a selection-score policy, not an absolute latency claim.

default.source: Compatibility fallback converted from the former SIMD indirect-store seed: 0.125 logical 32-lane transactions/system_cycle.

fadd.f32.source: Normalized endpoint calibration in atomic_profile_benchmark.py. SIMD is the reference scale; route-relative ratios are constrained by unique-address and all-hotspot measurements.

stage_resources.source: Ascend950 microarchitecture issue limits plus provisional conservative dependency rates; replace numeric seeds only through versioned CaModel/microbenchmark evidence.

camodel_effective.description: Workload-effective CaModel issue rates retained as fallback calibration context. The current Route Model consumes only the predicate rate from the nested rate map.
camodel_effective.note: These are effective issue rates for one FBGEMM workload, including its dependencies and stalls. They are fallback calibration seeds, not isolated instruction peak throughput or latency.

shuffle.description: SIMT workload-effective shuffle rate resolved from the shared runtime-loop microbenchmark. Route-level generalization confidence is intentionally lower than measurement repeatability.

memory.description: SIMT workload-effective GM load/store rates resolved from sequential rotating runtime-loop measurements. Indirect/random/coalescing behavior is not calibrated by these rates.

stage_resources.description: Generic SIMT front-end, spill, indirect-memory, and control-flow rates used by every SIMT StageCostModel. The indirect values are provisional seeds pending the next same-shape CaModel calibration.

prefix_scan.description: SIMT shuffle throughput already represents the lane dependency chain measured by the A5 scan sweep.

atomic_memory.description: Atomic RMW is priced independently from ordinary store and loaded-index load traffic. For loaded-index fadd.f32, the unknown-contention multiplier conservatively preserves the measured hotspot ordering while retaining the measured unique-address base ordering.

default.source: Compatibility fallback converted from the former SIMT indirect-store seed: 0.5 logical 32-lane transactions/system_cycle.

fadd.f32.source: Normalized endpoint calibration: unique addresses SIMD/SIMT=464.167491/239.297003 us fixes the base throughput ratio; all-hotspot SIMD/SIMT=8503.260612/13636.185646 us fixes the relative unknown-contention multiplier.

superblock.description: Independent logical programs may continue hiding latency through F4. The 8 B/system-cycle persistent-state rate is shared by the generic SIMD loop-carried-state term and by the extra pressure of replicating that state in SIMT SuperBlock; state replication is pressure-free only through F2. The rule consumes SSA live-out bytes and contains no workload-name check.

scope_handoff.description: Only exact tensor values captured by or returned from scope.scope are charged. A value crosses the distinct SIMD/SIMT register files through UB: producer store plus consumer load. The fixed pair is the measured operational intercept of one complete local SIMD-to-SIMT-to-SIMD scope and includes VF entry/prologue and exit/epilogue, but excludes tensor handoff bytes and SIMT body work. One scope-local SuperBlock group pays this fixed pair once, so the per-logical-program route score amortizes only the fixed term by factor; UB bytes and Stage work remain unscaled.

stage_resources.source: Ascend950 SIMT issue limits plus provisional conservative dependency/reconvergence, SuperBlock state-pressure, and scope hand-off rates; replace numeric seeds only through versioned CaModel/microbenchmark evidence.

scalar_memory.description: SIMT warp-uniform scalar white-box: diff-line load T=prep+fill+(K-1)*issue (fill=480 joint refit); first scalar store T=base. Values are CAModel core cycles converted by 988.9/1800.

mixed_setup_fallback.note: These values are mode1(empty SIMT plus tail barrier) minus mode6(barrier only) in a branch-heavy harness. They contain no SIMD Stage and are used only as conservative setup fallbacks. Directional SIMD-to-SIMT, SIMT-to-SIMD, and dependent UB hand-off costs remain unmeasured.
